name: studymate

nodes.name: load_memory_node
nodes.title: Load memory
nodes.description: Reads the user's structured profile from the LangGraph Store (namespace users/<user_id>/profile) so every later node can personalise. Also resets per-run state.

nodes.name: router_node
nodes.title: Intent router
nodes.description: Classifies the request (forced by the endpoint > keyword rules > LLM classifier > default). Its return value drives the conditional edge.

nodes.name: explanation_node
nodes.title: Explain
nodes.description: Builds a personalised system prompt, trims the history to the token budget, and asks the LLM for an explanation.

nodes.name: quiz_node
nodes.title: Generate quiz
nodes.description: Asks the LLM for a validated JSON multiple-choice quiz (topic, difficulty, number of questions).

nodes.name: summarization_node
nodes.title: Summarise notes
nodes.description: Produces summary, concepts, revision notes and key terms; long material is chunked (map-reduce) to fit the budget.

nodes.name: general_node
nodes.title: General / preference
nodes.description: Handles greetings and acknowledges stated learning preferences (the preference itself is persisted by memory_update_node).

nodes.name: response_node
nodes.title: Compose response
nodes.description: Converts generated_content to Markdown and appends the assistant message. The messages channel uses the add_messages reducer.

nodes.name: memory_update_node
nodes.title: Update memory
nodes.description: Extracts durable learning facts (style, language, subjects, preferences) with a controlled allow-list and writes them to the Store; records studied topics.

messages.behaviour: Appends new messages; a message with an existing id replaces it. History is never dropped.

learning_insights.behaviour: Merges by (kind, topic): repeats increment count and union intents instead of replacing the list.

execution_metadata.behaviour: Appends node trace entries within a run; the first node resets it for each new run.
